archive.sourceOrder: read selectors.sourceOrder and selectors.idOrder from the workflow manifest
archive.contains: raw source findings, lens coverage, reports, and gaps
archive.doesNotContain: semantic merged views or engine validation flags; those remain inline

resume.how: Workflow({scriptPath, resumeFromRunId: <this run's runId>}, {...same args, resultMode: "full"})
resume.onlyIf: this engine script and the hook-injected rails are byte-identical to this run. An edit to either since the run changes every agent prompt, so every agent re-runs at full cost; then read archive.commands.full instead.
resume.why: resultMode is read only when this result is rendered — it never reaches an agent() prompt or option — so an already-completed agent() call with an unchanged prompt replays from cache.
resume.contains: the complete processed state: every merged finding and engine flag in full, plus every source and per-lens row, none clipped or omitted.
